summary: Iteration 13 (Dhara / MSafe Legal Aid) — end-to-end backend + frontend verification of the 4 new features (cheque bounce NI 138, cyber fraud IT/1930/RBI, state layer, Save My Answers) plus MV/RTI retrieval regressions and Royal Blue + Gold theme. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests passed serially (`-n 0`), covering /api/reference/states (36 entries, 28 states + 8 UTs), PATCH /api/auth/state set/invalid/clear + /api/auth/me shape, chat retrieval integrity for NI 138 / cyber / Delhi rent, SSE frame types state_prompt (no state set) and state_note (DL traffic-fine), citation-integrity check that model reply contains no 'Section' / 'Article' / act names / section numbers, bookmarks CRUD idempotence + soft delete + auth (401 without token), and MV 194D / MV 199A / RTI 8 / RTI 18 / Article 22 / /api/voice/tts regressions. Frontend: mobile viewport 390×844 — logged in as protest@gandhikar.in, saw the 5-tab layout (Ask/Rights/Saved/History/Settings), Settings pick-state row opens state-screen, search 'Delhi' → state-DL → state-save persists and returns to Settings showing 'Delhi (NCT) · local rent, liquor and fine rules added'. Sent a chat question, tapped save-<msgId>, verified the item appears on the Saved tab (saved-screen) with question + answer + delete icon, delete removes it from the list. Cleared testuser@gandhikar.in's state via API, then logged in as that user and asked 'How much security deposit can my landlord ask for?' — a gold state-prompt-<msgId> card appeared under the assistant answer and tapping it navigates to state-screen. Royal Blue + Gold theme is applied consistently — no orange/terracotta remnants in /app/frontend/app or /app/frontend/src; /upgrade text has no 'Claude Sonnet' mention. No deprecated Expo packages found in the touched screens (all use expo-router, SafeAreaView from react-native-safe-area-context, Ionicons — clean).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:451-459 PATCH /api/auth/state correctly validates via is_valid_state(), stores upper-cased code (or None on clear), and returns {ok,state,state_name} — matches the frontend contract in auth.tsx setUserState / state.tsx onSave.

server.py:786-806 emits state_prompt when a state-sensitive topic is asked with no user_state AND no state_hits; emits state_note when user has a state but no verified local rule exists. Both frames precede the LLM delta, so the FE gold card lands under the answer regardless of streaming order — verified in UI.

server.py:867-922 bookmarks are keyed by (user_id, client_id) with upsert + $setOnInsert on id → truly idempotent PUT. DELETE is soft ({deleted:true, deleted_at:...}) and the GET filter {deleted: {$ne:true}} keeps tombstones out — a second device can't resurrect. No _id leakage (projection strips both _id and user_id).

server.py:585-604 the citation-integrity void-check for explicit BNS/BNSS/etc identifiers is still present. Cheque-bounce query with just the numeral '138' now correctly returns NI 138 alone (no CMVR 138(3) false-positive) because the NI corpus entry outscores it — the retrieval-tuning fix from prior iteration is holding.

corpus.py — RETRIEVAL_MIN_SCORE=4 with a 50%-of-top-score relative cutoff is doing its job: every one of the review-request test queries returned only genuinely relevant chips (no RTI/rent chip appeared on the cheque or cyber query, and vice-versa).

state.tsx:12-49 duplicates STATES from backend as an offline FALLBACK constant — worth noting because it must be kept in sync manually. It IS in sync today (36 entries, same codes/names). Not a bug, just a maintenance foot-gun to flag.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the flows requested — 5 tabs, state pick+save, bookmark round-trip, saved-tab list + delete, state-prompt card + nav, Royal Blue + Gold theme, no Claude Sonnet on /upgrade

seed_data_creation: None — testuser@gandhikar.in's state was cleared via /api/auth/state (payload {state:''}) so the state_prompt UI test could reproduce; protest@gandhikar.in was left with state=DL as the credentials file documents. One bookmark was created + deleted end-to-end via the UI, so DB is clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests with: `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_iteration_13_state_bookmarks_ni_cyber.py -n 0 --tb=short` (serial to avoid xdist state races on the shared preview backend). The suite auto-restores protest@gandhikar.in to state=DL at the end of TestAuthState.test_clear_state_then_restore so the file is safely re-runnable. testuser@gandhikar.in should be kept in the 'no state set' condition for the state_prompt UI test; the top of the frontend test flow patches state='' before it logs in as that user. All routes needed the /api prefix and the EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env — no localhost anywhere. Two harmless console warnings observed on web preview: 'expo-file-system is not supported on web' (fired by expo-audio when auto-speak plays TTS on web — unavoidable on preview, works in a native build) and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' from an internal RN Web component — neither is user-visible.
